prior_information: All earlier r7 and glint-review results inspected. July scenes are development data. No cover labels will be read or scored.
input: Repack immutable cached TOA reflectance and geometry GeoTIFFs into L1R NetCDF. Verify every array exactly; preserve native resolution and projection. PNeo uses full delivered footprint; S2 uses existing grid extent covering all evaluation cells plus 5.1 km on every side. No reflectance resampling in packaging.
calibration: Original offshore/habitat masks and evaluation grid. West/east 100m block split with centre-column purge as in preceding glint review. No habitat pixels used for glint slopes.

processing.S2_controls: Each RAdCor run writes rhosu (homogeneous-surface comparator) and rhos (adjacency corrected) using identical aerosol and geometry. Both retained before and after the same standard SWIR glint function.
PNeo: DSF fixed original marine aerosol/AOT 0.078115806, no glint: source reconstruction control
DSF original percentile selection with continental aerosol only, no glint: aerosol-family sensitivity
processing.PNeo_glint: Uncorrected; empirical zero and empirical training-p05 baseline, slopes fitted on train reference only, native subtraction before 10m means. Full-reference previews reported separately.
processing.PNeo_adjacency: Unavailable in pinned checkout: no PNEO3 coefficient files; original Pleiades coefficients will not be substituted.

water: Three pre-existing winter spectral shapes (Dec24, Feb22, median), each with KD490/BBP443 nominal and +/- producer errors: 27 externally specified states per scene. CDM error-lower-bound conflicts retained and flagged. No optical state selected using image fit. Not a probability distribution; summer shape and reef representativeness remain unvalidated.
evaluation: Paired blue/green/coastal/red diagnostics, retained negative reflectance, coverage, block summaries, shore-distance groups, both-band finite-depth water closure at +/-0.001 and +/-0.002 rhos. Compare all eligible support and common support. Report held-out regions separately. No threshold tuned for a favourable result.
stop: No cover/classifier run or physical-validation claim from this development comparison. If image/water closure remains inconsistent, document causes and next independent constraint. Qualifying shallow-bottom tests remains conditional.
preservation: Pinned upstream ACOLITE and all prior benchmark files unchanged. New cache/evidence directory only. No commit or publication.
